scenes.text: Follow a task from a user's time bucket. Inspect calls, agent lanes, and cumulative cost. This is synthetic data.
Install ClickHouse and its schema, the OpenTelemetry Collector, and an authenticated dashboard. Then configure each client.
Agent lanes show calls, tools, and waits. Costs retain their reported or estimated basis. Capture remains partial.
Select a call to inspect input, output, and cache tokens. Missing fields stay unavailable. Tokens are not invoices.
Select a model to highlight its calls. Codex diagnostic traces and metrics do not add to completion costs.
Choose a virtual machine or container platform. Lambda needs runtime adaptation. Follow the guides for backend prerequisites.
